name: Eggroll in a Bowl
author: Chari Crawley
steps: In a large, deep skillet, brown the sausage.
Meanwhile in a small bowl, combine garlic, soy sauce, and ginger; set aside.
Once sausage is cooked through, add the bag of dry coleslaw mix to skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the soy sauce mixture into the skillet and stir, continuing to cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until cabbage is wilted, but still a bit crunchy. Serve with sliced green onion.
